title: EthMail
tagline: EthMail enables seamless Web3-native invoicing with reduced risk, faster payment confirmation.
description: EthMail is a decentralized communication and invoicing platform that combines OAuth 2.0-based Gmail authentication, Flow blockchain-based identity and security, and Celo blockchain-based payment settlement to enable trustless, verifiable crypto invoicing through familiar email interfaces. By integrating email login, blockchain identity binding, and wallet-based transaction workflows, EthMail enables seamless Web3-native invoicing with reduced risk, faster payment confirmation, and a simplified user experience.
how_its_made:
EthMail bridges the gap between Web2 communication and Web3 transaction logic by integrating:
•	OAuth 2.0 Gmail Login – Allows users to sign in using their Gmail account, enabling quick onboarding with trusted identity providers.
•	Flow Blockchain Identity Layer – Anchors email accounts to verifiable, tamper-proof blockchain identities and enables future use of NFT-based mailbox ownership.
•	Celo Blockchain Payments – Facilitates low-cost, mobile-friendly crypto transactions that can be tied directly to emails and invoices.
By combining these technologies, EthMail enables:
•	Secure crypto invoicing directly from email
•	Trustless verification of sender/receiver identity
•	Linked message-to-transaction workflows
•	Real-time payment tracking and confirmations
